text:
arjun: Quick scan of pavo-11b bring-up. Ran fp16 vs GPTQ-int8 on representative GTN slices. TL;DR: int8 saves ~42% unit cost, p50 latency down ~18%, but longform QA/summarization quality drops ~1.8 pts on our longform slice. Sheet + samples: https://go.redwood/pavo11b-scan :bar_chart:

maya: can you paste the headline numbers?

arjun: Sure — sample = ~10k requests across short/medium/long slices. Unit cost (approx): fp16 = $0.012/token, int8 = $0.0072/token. p50 latency fp16 = 210ms, int8 = 173ms. p95 tail: fp16 = 650ms, int8 = 720ms (tail worse for long sequences). Quality deltas: short QA: -0.1 F1, conversational summarization (long): -1.8 ROUGE-L.

sophia: p95 regression worries me — why is tail worse on int8?

arjun: Hypothesis: different attention kernel path for >1024 tokens + partial KV cache alignment. Our int8 runtime uses a fallback attention kernel for long sequences which has worse memory access patterns; also saw GC pauses on g5x2 host type.

tom: Can we do hybrid routing — int8 for typical short queries and fp16 for long ones?

arjun: Yes. I tested a simple prefix-length heuristic: route to fp16 if prompt_tokens > 800 OR expected_response_len > 600. Keeps long-form quality & p95 but still yields ~26% cost reduction overall vs fp16-only. Example router snippet: ```
model=pavo-11b
quant=GPTQ-int8
max_len=2048
batch=8
```

arjun: And logic we used in the router was: ```
if prompt_tokens > 800 or est_resp > 600:
  route = "pavo-11b-fp16"
else:
  route = "pavo-11b-int8"
```

nora: @arjun this looks promising. For GTN product, can we default to int8 and opt into fp16 for the "compose"/longform flow? Need a clear canary + rollback plan.

arjun: Recommend: canary 5% traffic with shadow fp16 logging for 48h. Pass criteria: no >0.5% degradation on short QA F1, <1.0 BLEU/ROUGE drop on summarization slices, p95 latency SLO <700ms. Rollback: route that flow to fp16 or raise threshold to 0% if any safety regressions.

maya: :thumbsup: I'll set up the canary and loop in GTN owners. @arjun please drop raw eval artifacts in the sheet.

arjun: Done — sheet updated and artifacts uploaded to gs://redwood-evals/pavo11b/2026-03-19/ . Samples/diffs there. Ping me if you need access.

prod-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout scheduled: pavo-11b-int8 -> 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC at 5% (staging).

sophia: small ask — int8 had slightly higher hallucination rate on citation tasks in the small slice. Can we add a targeted citation priming test?

arjun: Good call. Will run a 5k-turn citation slice overnight and post results tomorrow.

arjun: Summary recommendation for now: default to int8 for latency/cost-sensitive routes, hybrid-route fp16 for longform/compose flows, 5% canary + 48h shadow fp16, rollback guardrails as above.
